shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular stone block/slab
figures rendered in strict profile (animal heads in A, human head in B)
horizontal band or line dividing the surface
rows of repeated small units (zigzag/chevron band in A; rows of beaded curls and dot-rows in B)
an eye rendered as an outlined shape in profile
justification: Both are shallow relief carvings on rectangular stone surfaces that place their subjects in rigid profile and organise part of the field with a horizontal band above rows of repeated small motifs. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A stacks numerous small, schematic, flatly outlined animal and abstract forms into stacked registers, while B is dominated by a single large, finely modelled human head and shoulder filling the whole panel with carefully graded volume and dense ornamental detail.
